dct_description_sm: The focus of this project was to implement Inuit Circumpolar Council's (ICC) climate change adaptation strategy ensuring that Inuit concerns and priorities are considered, as well as scientific perspectives, in climate change decision making in Aboriginal and northern communities in the Canadian Arctic.
dct_subject_sm: Social sciences, economics and policy -> Adaptation
Social sciences, economics and policy -> Policy
dct_title_s: Inuit and Climate Change Challenges: Creating Adaptation and Mitigation Strategies
